pom.sj_sort: Sort the sweets! Every jar gets one kind.
pom.sj_how_many: How many of these are in the jars?
pom.sj_most: Which jar has the most? Tap it!
pom.sj_fewest: Which jar has the fewest? Tap it!
pom.sj_tip_shape: Look at its shape. Find the jar with the same shape.
pom.sj_tip_size: Is it a big one or a little one?
pom.sj_tip_move: Find a jar with the same sweet on top, or an empty jar.
pom.sj_tip_count: Point to each sweet and count them, from the bottom.
pom.sj_tip_tall: Look at how high each jar is filled.

mumba.sw_intro: Welcome to the big match! Let's fill the stand.
mumba.sw_pattern: Let's make a pattern with the cards! Tap a card to change its colour, then press the button.
mumba.sw_continue: What colour comes next? Tap the next card.
mumba.sw_how_many: How many Peeps are in the stand?
mumba.sw_how_many_cols: How many Peeps in each row?
mumba.sw_groups: Every row has the same. How many Peeps altogether?
mumba.sw_tip_pattern: A pattern repeats. Make the first cards, then make them again.
mumba.sw_tip_say: Say the colours out loud from the start.
mumba.sw_tip_row: Count one row first. Then count on, one row at a time.
mumba.sw_tip_rows: Rows go across. Count them from the front.
mumba.sw_twin: A new crowd! Let's go again.

bim.lm_intro: Welcome to our lemonade stand! The Peeps are thirsty!
bim.lm_pour_half: Half a glass, please! Hold the tap, and let go at the line.
bim.lm_pour_quarter: A quarter of a glass, please! Hold the tap, and let go at the line.
bim.lm_pour_three_quarters: Three quarters of a glass, please! Hold the tap, and let go at the line.
bim.lm_pour_third: A third of a glass, please! Hold the tap, and let go at the line.
bim.lm_pour_two_thirds: Two thirds of a glass, please! Hold the tap, and let go at the line.
bim.lm_smaller: Which glass has the smaller parts? Tap it!
bim.lm_bigger: Which glass has the bigger parts? Tap it!
bim.lm_count_halves: How many halves fill the glass?
bim.lm_count_thirds: How many thirds fill the glass?
bim.lm_count_quarters: How many quarters fill the glass?
bim.lm_which_third: Which glass is a third full?
bim.lm_which_quarter: Which glass is a quarter full?
bim.lm_tip_half: Count the parts of the glass. How many parts does a half need?
bim.lm_tip_quarter: Count the parts of the glass. How many parts does a quarter need?
bim.lm_tip_third: Count the parts of the glass. How many parts does a third need?
bim.lm_tip_more_parts: The more parts a glass has, the... ? Look at one part of each.
bim.lm_tip_which: Count the equal parts in each glass. Look at how much is filled.
bim.rj_intro: Ramp jump! Let's see how far they fly.
bim.rj_further: Which one jumped further? Tap its flag.
bim.rj_shorter: Which jump was shorter? Tap its flag.
bim.rj_tip_further: Look how far each flag is from the ramp.
bim.rj_order: Tap the flags in order. Shortest jump first, longest last.
bim.rj_rope: These two tracks are far apart. Tap the rope to measure the top one.
bim.rj_rope2: Now tap the rope again. It goes beside the other track.
bim.rj_which_longer: Which track is longer? Tap its flag.
bim.rj_tip_rope: Look at the end of the rope. Does the track go past it?
bim.rj_blocks: How long is the track? Tap to lay a block. Go right to the flag, with no gaps. Then tap the tick.
bim.rj_tip_blocks: The last block must just reach the flag.
bim.rj_how_many_blocks: How many blocks long is it?
bim.rj_read: How far did it jump? Read the ruler.
bim.rj_tip_read: Look straight down from the flag to the ruler.
bim.rj_place: Drag the flag to this number on the ruler. Then tap the tick.
bim.rj_tip_place: Find this number on the ruler first.
bim.rj_ruler: Slide the ruler. Put its zero right at the end.
bim.rj_read_ruler: How long is it? Read the ruler.
bim.rj_tip_ruler: Look straight down from the other end to the ruler.
bim.rj_tool: Which tool would you use to measure this?
bim.rj_tool_stick: A metre stick, for things about as big as you.
bim.rj_tool_tape: A long tape, for very long things.
bim.rj_tip_tool: Is it small, or as big as you, or very long?
bim.rj_thing_road: The whole road round the bay.
bim.rj_lay_small: Tap the small blocks to lay them all along.
bim.rj_lay_big: Now tap the big blocks to lay them along.
bim.rj_which_more: Which blocks did it take more of?
bim.rj_units_why: Small blocks, so more of them. Big blocks, so fewer.
bim.rj_how_much_further: How much further did the far one go?
bim.rj_tip_longer: Count the metres between the two flags.
bim.rj_story: Read the story, and look at the bars. How many metres?
bim.rj_tip_story: Do the bars join up, or do we want the gap?
bim.rj_plot: Put a dot above the number where it landed.
bim.rj_tip_plot: Read the number on the flag. Find it on the ruler.
bim.rj_plot_how_many: How many jumps landed on this number?
bim.rj_plot_most: Which length came up the most? Tap its number.
bim.rj_plot_total: How many jumps are there in all?
bim.rj_tip_plot_count: Each dot is one jump. Count the dots.
bim.rj_end: What a day of jumping! Thank you!
bim.rj_about_how_long: About how long was that jump? Look at the ruler. Which number is closest?
bim.rj_about_flag: Which flag is at about this number on the ruler?
bim.rj_about_place: Drag the flag to about this number on the ruler. Then tap the tick.
bim.rj_tip_about: Look straight down from the flag. Which number is closest?

bam.cc_end: What a builder! Cube Island is finished!
bam.lr_intro: Oh no! The Peeps are stuck up the palm tree! Let's rescue them with our ladders.
bam.lr_reach: Which ladder is long enough to reach the Peep?
bam.lr_shortest: This Peep is on a little crate. Find the shortest ladder!
bam.lr_taller: Two Peeps are stuck! Which stack is taller? Tap it!
bam.lr_shorter_stack: Two Peeps are stuck! Which stack is shorter? Tap it!
bam.lr_longer: Which ladder is longer? Tap it!
bam.lr_shorter: Which ladder is shorter? Tap it!
bam.lr_order_long: Let's line up the ladders. Tap the longest one first.
bam.lr_order_short: Let's line up the ladders. Tap the shortest one first.
bam.lr_yes1: You did it! Down you come!
bam.lr_tip_tops: Look at the tops of the ladders. Which one goes up as high as the Peep?
bam.lr_tip_low: Look at the tops of the ladders. Which one stops lowest?
bam.lr_tip_stacks: Count the crates in each stack.
bam.lr_tip_line_up: Let's stand them side by side on the sand. Now look at the tops!
bam.lr_tip_order: Look at all the tops. Which one is the longest?
bam.lr_tip_order_short: Look at all the tops. Which one is the shortest?

digsy.cf_intro: Welcome to my cupcake factory! My machine needs the right number to work.
digsy.cf_tray: How many cupcakes are on this tray?
digsy.cf_groups: How many cupcakes are there in all?
digsy.cf_tip_rows: Count the cupcakes in one row. Then count the rows.
digsy.cf_tip_groups: Count the cupcakes on one tray. Then count the trays.
digsy.cf_hic: Hic! The machine has the hiccups. Let's look again.
digsy.cf_watch: Let me work it out with you.
digsy.cf_yes2: Whirr, whirr! The machine likes that number!
digsy.cf_end: Look what the machine made! A giant cupcake for everyone!

noodle.wr_intro: Here comes the wall! Help the Peeps fit through the hole.
noodle.wr_picture: Which shapes make the picture in the wall? Tap them!
noodle.wr_two: Two shapes make this hole. Which two?
noodle.wr_three: This hole needs three shapes. Find them!
noodle.wr_sides: The hole has this many sides. Which shape has the same?
noodle.wr_count: How many squares will fill this hole?
noodle.wr_tip_look: Look at the hole's corners and sides. Which tile matches?
noodle.wr_tip_sides: Count the sides of the hole, then count the sides on each tile.
noodle.wr_tip_row: Find out how many fit along one row first.
noodle.sn_yes1: It fits! Look at the colours!

fizz.lt_light_quarter: Light a quarter of this window! Then tap Lights on.
fizz.lt_light_three_quarters: Light three quarters of this window! Then tap Lights on.
fizz.lt_light_third: Light a third of this window! Then tap Lights on.
fizz.lt_light_two_thirds: Light two thirds of this window! Then tap Lights on.
fizz.lt_light_half_circle: Light a half circle! Then tap Lights on.
fizz.lt_light_quarter_circle: Light a quarter circle! Then tap Lights on.
fizz.lt_which_half: Which window is half lit? Tap it!
fizz.lt_which_quarter: Which window is a quarter lit? Tap it!
fizz.lt_which_three_quarters: Which window is three quarters lit? Tap it!
fizz.lt_which_third: Which window is a third lit? Tap it!
fizz.lt_which_two_thirds: Which window is two thirds lit? Tap it!
fizz.lt_which_quarter_circle: Which window shows a quarter circle lit? Tap it!
fizz.lt_fair_halves: Which window is split into fair halves?
fizz.lt_fair_quarters: Which window is split into fair quarters?
fizz.lt_different: Tap a window that's half lit!
fizz.lt_both: They're both half lit! Halves can look different.
fizz.lt_tip_parts: How many panes are there? A half is one of two equal parts.
fizz.lt_tip_quarter: A quarter is one of four equal parts.
fizz.lt_tip_third: A third is one of three equal parts.
fizz.lt_tip_fair: Fair parts are all exactly the same size. Look closely!
fizz.lt_end: The whole street is shining! Let's party!
